title: Calculated
paragraphs: “Ren-san, what’s wrong?”
“No, I was just thinking… what if we were exactly like Kou back in the first world?”
“What do you mean by that?”
“Think about it. If Itsuki, Motoyasu, and I treated Naofumi the same way Kou just did…”
“Ah… I see what you’re getting at…”
So, Ren, Itsuki, and I looked down on Naofumi, treating him like some weak, useless shield-user…? That’s exactly what happened in the first world.
“In other words, the future versions of us probably looked down on Naofumifather, just like Kou did earlier.”
“I’d really like to deny that, but if I assume it’s true… wow, that’s seriously annoying.”

And it wasn’t just one Kou. It was the three of us. On top of that, there was that crimson swine, the Trash King, and the Three Heroes Church. Anyone in Father’s position would’ve snapped. It’s only natural.
“Nano!”
Oh? My rival has started talking. I don’t have time to deal with you right now. Stay quiet.
“Hmm? Gaelion-chan is making some strange sounds.”
“…Nice… to… meet, nano!”
She’s flicking her tongue out in a way that’s clearly meant to be cute. So calculated. No one called for you.
“Is ‘nano’ just something she adds at the end? Looks like she’s really starting to talk.”
“Yeah. Gaelion, grow up to be just as great as your father.”
“Lea…ve it… to me, nano!”
Her intonation is still a little weird. Then, my rival starts playing around with the mole and says:
“Gaelion… protect… from… Filolials, nano!”
“Oh, so Gaelion-chan actually understands what’s going on.”
“Nano! Gaelion… wants… to be liked… by Naofumi, nano!”
Father’s smile froze in place. The assistant was completely dumbfounded.
“Kou-san is innocent, but Gaelion-san seems… calculating.”
“It sounded like she was saying she’d protect Imiya just to get on Naofumi’s good side.”
“You sure have a lot of unique companions now, Naofumi. Isn’t that great?”
“I wouldn’t say I’m particularly happy about it…”
“Nano!”

My rival’s self-assertion irritated both me and the Filolial-sama. And so, that night, we all rested soundly at the inn. The next day arrived. That morning, as usual, Father played with Sakura-chan and the others before preparing for departure. My rival joined in, and things got quite intense.
“Alright, today we really need to get to Faubrey.”
“Yeah… Honestly, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say this is urgent. Without a doubt, something abnormal is happening in Melromarc.”
Éclair conveys her thoughts with a serious expression.
“Yeah, we understand. There are some discrepancies with what Motoyasu-kun told us, and more importantly, we’ve been conducting our own investigations within the country.”
“Yes, we should head there as soon as possible.”
“Regarding that, I have several tasks entrusted to me by the previous Father. Would it be alright if we departed after I finish those?”
“Is there something specific?”
“It’s to swiftly and efficiently resolve the issues in Faubrey.”
“Hm? Motoyasu, could you explain that in simpler terms?”
“Of course.”
I proceeded to explain the key points of what the previous Father had taught me. Mainly about Takt, his pig-like subordinates, and the strategies for dealing with them.
“A person with the ability to steal Holy Weapons… So this guy has been causing trouble and stirring up chaos in previous loops?”
After my brief explanation, Ren furrowed his brows in thought.
“Exactly. The previous Father said, ‘That idiot thinks we’re some kind of boss enemies that drop weapons when defeated.’”
“There are games like that. I’ve played a few myself.”
“Who the hell is this guy, anyway?”
“He’s an enemy, that’s all you need to know.”
“There’s actually someone like that? Kitamura-dono, what is this person’s name?”
“He goes by Takt.”
“Takt… I’ve heard stories about a so-called genius from Faubrey.”
Éclair is surprisingly well-informed. As expected of a knight.
“Every single time, he calls us out just to mindlessly open fire on us like a broken record.”
“Well, if he’s the same person each time, his thinking won’t change. Wait… or does he do that even when the situation is different?”
“Precisely. No matter the circumstances, he always attacks the same way.”
“…That’s quite the aggressive group of people.”
It’s getting tiresome. That’s why the previous Father shared his wisdom with me. I’d prefer to follow his instructions to the letter.
“Anyway, back to the point—did the previous Naofumi tell you anything specific?”
“He did.”
“Then I feel reassured. Motoyasu tends to handle things well when it’s something he learned from Naofumi. We’ll keep an eye on things from a safe distance.”
“Since there’s also the issue in Melromarc, I’ll double-check what the plan actually entails.”
“But still… what exactly is going to happen? Can we even defeat someone with that kind of ability?”
“With our current strength, we absolutely can. After all, in the first world, Father mastered the Four Holy and two Seven Star enhancement methods and completely obliterated him.”
“Naofumi did? How?”
“When his weapon was temporarily taken away, he was able to attack.”

At the time, I was part of a separate unit with Itsuki, dealing with the Wave, so I don’t know the full details. However, during our preparations, we conducted several training sessions. As a result, we discovered that Father’s low attack power was due to the influence of his shield.
“For us, who know the enhancement methods for all weapons, this shouldn’t be difficult at all. That’s reassuring.”
“But the subordinates are the real problem, right? Did you hear about that from Naofumi as well?”
“I did. You can rest easy.”
“Alright then. Let’s move out. Motoyasu, we’re counting on you.”

And so, we departed for Faubrey. It was practically within arm’s reach. Once we crossed the border, we sped along the country’s vast paved roads toward the capital, riding on the swift legs of the Filolials.
“The roads are paved, so there’s barely any shaking.”
“Yeah. That should help with motion sickness, I suppose…”
“I’ve gotten used to it by now.”
“Nano!”
The Rival soared ahead, leisurely carrying the assistant. Everything was going smoothly.
“You shall go no further, false heroes!”

Along the way, a large group of assassins from the Three Heroes Church ambushed us, but they were no match for our current strength. I, Itsuki, and Ren wiped them out with long-range skills from the carriage. As for their ritual magic, Father used a shield-based skill that deployed like an umbrella, completely nullifying their attacks. Not that it was even necessary—since the Rival and the Filolials could sense their magic beforehand, we already knew about the attack in advance. In terms of strength, they were laughable compared to the Melromarc army we faced in previous loops. Because of that, we reached Faubrey’s capital by the following morning.
“Motoyasu was right—this country is scientifically advanced.”
“They have cars. It’s like a full-on steampunk world… maybe?”
“I saw a shop selling firearms earlier. Looks like they deal in guns here.”
“That’s right, Itsuki can handle guns, can’t he?”
“Thinking of switching to a gunslinger class?”
“Why are you bringing that up again?”
Whenever we talked about Faubrey, the topic would occasionally shift to Father and Ren teasing Itsuki. Itsuki didn’t outright deny it, though—he just gave a strained smile.
“So, this is Faubrey…”
“Is this your first time here, Imia-chan?”
“…Yeah.”
Father glanced toward the mole-girl looking out from the back of the carriage and asked.
“It’s amazing. Did anything here catch your interest, Imia-chan?”
“Hmm…”
“If there’s anything you want to know, just ask. I’ll help however I can.”
“Thank you.”
At that moment, the Rival swooped down and perched on the edge of the carriage.
Hey! Don’t land there without permission!
“Nano! The air feels bad here!”
“Probably because of the steam engines. The air might be polluted from the exhaust.”
“But I saw a weird flying machine!”
“They do have airplanes and airships here. Maybe even flying boats.”
“…Human technology is incredible.”
The assistant’s eyes widened as she curiously scanned the cityscape. Although, you are a human yourself. Well, a demi-human, technically.
What, do you think you’re a dragon or something?
“So, this is the capital of the largest country in this world. You see places like this in online games, but being here in person really leaves me speechless.”

Father spoke with the awe of someone witnessing something rare. Ren and Itsuki had similar expressions. Éclair, on the other hand, seemed familiar with the city, as she was giving directions to the Filolials pulling the carriage.
“First, we should prove our status as the Four Holy Heroes before heading to the castle. Let’s go to the Four Saints Church headquarters.”
“Oh yeah, that’s a legitimate religion that worships the Four Holy Heroes, right?”
“After dealing with the Three Heroes Church, it’s hard to put faith in any religion…”

Itsuki had a point. I only saw it as a harmless organization with no real impact. The Four Saints Church wasn’t an enemy—in fact, they were probably allies. But in reality, I didn’t know much about them at all.
“Going directly to the castle is an option, but I think it’s more prudent to have proof of our identity first.”
Come to think of it, in the first world, Father found the process bothersome and left everything to the Queen. Well, that was because she could just vouch for him without any issue.
